# Symbolic System

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SymbolicSystem>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)

A system of symbols, signs, or conventions used for communication, representation, or expression. Broad umbrella covering notation systems, gesture systems, emoji conventions, platform conventions, and other non-linguistic symbol systems. NOT a language by default; a standpointed claim may classify a symbolic system as a language ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:SymbolicSystem`](gmeow-SymbolicSystem.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:InformationObject`](gmeow-InformationObject.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
